suitelet.description: CWP ARCH bundle split write path. Posts the Inventory Adjustment that splits a lot and trues the Sales Order line up to the measured quantities. Runs as Administrator because warehouse and trader roles cannot write inventory adjustments; authorisation is therefore enforced in script against custscript_arch_split_roles, which fails closed to Administrator only when unset.
suitelet.name: MCGI SL ARCH Split Execute

scriptcustomfield.description: Comma separated role internal IDs permitted to complete a bundle split. Leave EMPTY until the warehouse role is settled with the client: empty means Administrator only, which is the safe default for a deployment that writes as Administrator. Administrator is always retained even if omitted from the list, so a bad entry cannot lock out the person who has to fix it.
scriptcustomfield.help: Example: 1057,1063. Empty is safe and means Administrator only.
scriptcustomfield.label: Permitted Split Roles

scriptcustomfield.description: Internal id of the GL account bundle-split Inventory Adjustments post to. 228 is "8900000 Rounding Gain/Loss", which Marc-Antoine named on 2026-09-09 and which is already the adjustment account on 140 existing inventory adjustments in this account. It was 612 "9999997 Temp Inventory" until then; that was chosen before the split conserved value, and it is an other-current-asset account, so the $526.62 the old two-line shape invented sat in a hidden asset rather than showing up. A conserved split posts only its rounding here, which is what this account is for. Configured here rather than accepted from the browser: the screen must not be able to choose where a write posts. Splits refuse to complete if this is empty.
scriptcustomfield.help: Defaults to 228, 8900000 Rounding Gain/Loss. Change this only with the client: it is where a split's rounding lands.
scriptcustomfield.label: Split Adjustment Account
